This '''trader''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Hig]],<ref name="YJK" /> a slender blue-skinned [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="SWE" /> She owned an automated [[Ore/Legends|ore]] [[Starship/Legends|hauler]] which, in [[24 ABY/Legends|24 ABY]], she donated to the [[Diversity Alliance]], a pro-[[Alien/Legends|alien]], anti-[[Human/Legends|Human]] organization. While she occasionally [[Pilot/Legends|piloted]] the ship herself, she preferred to let the autopilot control most cargo runs, instead spending her time relaxing in a [[Cantina/Legends|cantina]] on a backwater [[Planet/Legends|planet]].<ref name="YJK" />

Her ore hauler was used by four members of the [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]] to infiltrate the Diversity Alliance operations on the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]].<ref name="YJK" />
